# cowr 

An R client for 'CoW Protocol': built for quantitative traders, researchers, and DeFi developers.


## Features

-   Place limit and market orders directly from R\
-   Query the CoW Protocol subgraph using `GraphQL` → tidy tibbles\
-   Upload and pin appData to `IPFS`\
-   Automatic developer attribution (UTM tags) on every order\
-   Full EIP-712 signing support (via private key or custom signer)\
-   Built-in rate limiting, error handling, and informative messages\
-   Designed for backtesting, research, and production trading workflows

## Installation

``` r
# from CRAN (when published)
# install.packages("cowr")

# from GitHub (development version)
if (!require("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("sawsimeon/cowr")
```

## Quick Start

``` r
library(cowr)

# Connect to Gnosis Chain (mainnet, gnosis, arbitrum, sepolia supported)
cowr_connect("gnosis")

# Query recent orders
orders <- cowr_get_orders(limit = 50, status = "open")
head(orders)

# Query the subgraph (returns tibble)
query <- '{
  orders(first: 10, orderBy: creationTime, orderDirection: desc) {
    id
    owner
    trades { transaction { id } }
  }
}'
recent <- cowr_subgraph_query(query)
recent
```

## Placing an Order (with automatic attribution)

``` r
# Example: Sell 10 GNO for USDC on Gnosis Chain
order <- list(
  sellToken = "0x6810e776880c02933d47db1b9fc05908e5386b96",  # GNO
  buyToken  = "0xe91d153e0b41518a2ce8dd3d7944fa863463a97d",  # WXDAI/USDC
  sellAmount = "10000000000000000000",  # 10 GNO
  buyAmount  = "2500000000",            # ~2,500 USDC (slippage buffer)
  validTo = as.integer(Sys.time()) + 1800,
  kind = "sell",
  partiallyFillable = FALSE
)

# Sign and submit (use with extreme caution on mainnet!)
# placed <- cowr_place_order(order, private_key = Sys.getenv("PK"))

# See current UTM attribution (enabled by default)
getOption("cowr.utm")
```

## Upload appData to IPFS

``` r

metadata <- list(
  app = "cowr-r-package",
  version = as.character(packageVersion("cowr")),
  environment = list(language = "R")
)

cid <- cowr_upload_appdata(metadata)
cat("Pinned to IPFS:", cid, "\n")
```

## Key Functions

| Function                | Description                                  |
|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| `cowr_connect()`        | Set active chain and API endpoints           |
| `cowr_get_orders()`     | Fetch orders from the production API         |
| `cowr_subgraph_query()` | Run arbitrary GraphQL queries → tibble       |
| `cowr_place_order()`    | Submit signed orders (with auto UTM tagging) |
| `cowr_order_status()`   | Check status of a specific order UID         |
| `cowr_upload_appdata()` | Pin JSON metadata to IPFS (via pinata.cloud) |
| `cowr_set_utm_tags()`   | Customize developer attribution tags         |
| `cowr_reset_utm_tags()` | Restore default attribution                  |
